name: student-lcs-both-empty
defect: Handles completely empty input strings without indexing errors or out-of-bounds exceptions.

name: student-lcs-one-empty
defect: Ensures empty string paired with non-empty string results in length 0 and empty sequence.

name: student-lcs-subsequence-skip
defect: Verifies that LCS correctly skips non-matching intercalated characters preserving relative order.

name: student-lcs-repeated-chars
defect: Checks that repeated characters are not greedily overcounted beyond the shorter sequence.

name: student-lcs-alternative-optimal
defect: Tests tied optimal subsequences (either A or B) and ensures correct length 1 is returned.

name: student-merge-zero-blocks
defect: Validates edge case n=0 returning zero cost and empty plan.

name: student-merge-one-block
defect: Validates edge case n=1 returning zero cost and empty plan.

name: student-merge-zeros
defect: Checks that zero-sized blocks are properly merged in valid intervals without zero-division or skipping.

name: student-merge-adjacent-vs-arbitrary
defect: Ensures DP merges strictly adjacent blocks and does not use greedy Huffman merge of non-adjacent elements.

name: student-merge-large-64bit
defect: Validates 64-bit integer arithmetic to prevent 32-bit signed overflow on large block sums.

name: student-tree-zero-vertices
defect: Tests base case of n=0 vertices producing weight 0 and empty selected list.

name: student-tree-one-positive
defect: Tests single positive vertex being selected.

name: student-tree-one-negative
defect: Ensures empty set (weight 0) is preferred over selecting a single negative vertex.

name: student-tree-all-negative
defect: Ensures that when all vertices have negative weights, empty set of weight 0 is returned.

name: student-tree-star-negative-root
defect: Checks that skipping a negative hub allows taking all its positive leaves, avoiding greedy root selection.

name: student-tree-chain-alternating
defect: Checks tree DP on alternating chain, verifying that no adjacent vertices are selected and sum is maximized.

name: student-search-empty-pattern-boundaries
defect: Verifies the contract requirement that an empty pattern matches all n+1 text boundaries.

name: student-search-empty-text
defect: Checks that searching non-empty pattern in empty text safely returns empty list.

name: student-search-both-empty
defect: Verifies that empty pattern in empty text returns position [0].

name: student-search-pattern-longer
defect: Ensures searching pattern longer than text returns [] without substring bounds errors.

name: student-search-case-punctuation
defect: Checks case sensitivity and punctuation handling in exact string matching.

name: student-search-overlaps
defect: Verifies overlapping match retention via prefix fallback rather than jumping by pattern length.

name: student-rk-ab-dj-collision
defect: Tests character verification on equal-hash collision between ab and dj (both hash 75 mod 101).

name: student-rk-bc-ek-collision
defect: Tests collision rejection between bc and ek (both hash 6 mod 101).

name: student-suffix-empty
defect: Validates empty text handling with empty sa, empty lcp, and empty repeated string.

name: student-suffix-single-char
defect: Checks single character text sa=[0], lcp=[0] with repeated="".

name: student-suffix-all-equal
defect: Tests prefix doubling and Kasai on homogeneous string with maximum overlapping repeats.

name: student-suffix-all-distinct
defect: Checks text with no repeating substrings, ensuring all LCP values are 0 and repeated is empty.

name: student-suffix-abracadabra
defect: Verifies suffix sorting and Kasai LCP on classic abracadabra with repeat abra of length 4.

name: student-aho-empty-dictionary
defect: Checks that empty patterns dictionary produces empty count row per input text.

name: student-aho-no-texts
defect: Checks that empty texts list produces empty counts list.

name: student-aho-empty-text
defect: Checks that empty text string produces row of zeros for all patterns.

name: student-aho-overlap-prefix-suffix
defect: Validates reverse-BFS failure link count propagation on multi-scale overlapping patterns.

name: student-aho-independent-texts-reset
defect: Ensures state and match counts reset completely between consecutive independent text evaluations.
